llm_reason: R2 evaluation (V1/V2/V3): all pass stage2 (ED/5C/mass); V3 passes 5C-discharge T_max 328.8 K; remaining failure = 4C-charge exam (V1 357.2 K, V2 343.6 K, V3 337.3 K vs 333.15). Fallback routing: symptom T_max/plating at cell scale -> Stage 3 (same scale): reduce polarization (transport+particles+sep porosity) and enlarge cooling surface (pouch geometry, architecture lever). Heat Q~hA*dT: need dT<=15 K at h=10 -> Q<=1.2 W at A=0.0075 vs ~1.0 W at A=0.00531 (V3 19.2 K). Both levers together give ~4-6 K margin. Plating already positive on V2/V3 (+15/+21 mV) and improves with transport. V5 = attribution control for cooling-area contribution. Sources: sigma 1.4 S/m and D 4.5e-10 near literature upper bound for LiPF6 EC/EMC; t+ 0.5 ESTIMATE (high-transference formulation, marked); sep porosity 0.55 literature (high-porosity ceramic/polyolefin); cooling area 0.0075 m2 = flatter pouch (cell volume 24.2 cm3, ~75 cm2 single-face cooling, conservative vs typical pouch); particles 1.0/1.5 um literature high-power electrode practice.
